title: Self-similar asymptotics in the decay problem for the Volterra lattice with zero boundary condition
summary: The article is devoted to the problem of decay of initial stationary state for the Volterra lattice with zero boundary condition. We show that this process is asymptotically self-similar and calculate the propagation velocity of the decay wave, the leading terms of the asymptotics and corrections, in the main and transition sectors of the wave.
